data.narrative: Chose a live deck for VP/Marketing Q&A on delaying subscription launch 3 weeks for a payment security fix. Translated token-replay via coat-check and unlocked-back-door analogies, opened with the date change, and ended with a concrete ask. Critiqued Marcus’s gateway email (~45 jargon hits, buried memory/scale risk) and rewrote it business-first.

dimension_scores.observation: Found the buried +42.5GB autoscaling risk and counted stakeholder-illegible jargon systematically.
Six one-idea slides; parent-test opening; FAQ table for pushback.
Wrote for Product/Marketing concerns (launch date, board/customer messaging), not eng implementation.
Impact → risk → plan → tradeoff → ask → FAQ; Marcus rewrite mirrors same arc.
Clear decisions: approve +3 weeks, update announcements, book Thursday sync; Marcus rewrite has go/no-go capacity proof.

strengths: Translated without simplifying away the 3-week cost.
Unburied capacity risk that Product would otherwise miss.
data.recommendation: Module 6: practice runbooks/escalation docs that stay actionable under incident pressure.
